mentions.name: CraftCX
mentions.description: CraftCX provides trust and observability for AI customer support tooling, evaluating how AI support agents perform and whether billed resolutions are genuinely good resolutions or just deflect customers without actually helping them.
mentions.problem: It's hard to know whether the resolutions you're billed for from AI customer support agents are good resolutions, or just deflecting the customer without helping.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://craftcx.com - Working on various aspects of trust and observability around the performance of AI Customer Support tooling. 
How's the support agent performing? 
Are the resolutions you're billed for "good" resolutions, or just deflecting the customer without helping?
